command:
set -eu
getent passwd root appsvc > /srv/app-chroot/etc/passwd
getent group root appsvc > /srv/app-chroot/etc/group
cat > /srv/app-chroot/opt/app/server.py <<'ANTRIEB_APP_EOF'
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
import os

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path not in ("/", "/health"):
            self.send_error(404)
            return
        body = ("chroot web application\nstatus=ok\nuid=%d\n" % os.getuid()).encode()
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/plain; charset=utf-8")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        print("%s - %s" % (self.address_string(), fmt % args), flush=True)

ThreadingHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", 8080), Handler).serve_forever()
ANTRIEB_APP_EOF
chmod 0644 /srv/app-chroot/opt/app/server.py /srv/app-chroot/etc/passwd /srv/app-chroot/etc/group
cat > /etc/systemd/system/chroot-web.service <<'ANTRIEB_UNIT_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Chrooted web application
Wants=network-online.target
After=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=appsvc
Group=appsvc
RootDirectory=/srv/app-chroot
WorkingDirectory=/opt/app
Environment=PYTHONHOME=/usr
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 -I /opt/app/server.py
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=2s
NoNewPrivileges=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes
CapabilityBoundingSet=
RestrictSUIDSGID=yes
RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_INET AF_INET6

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
ANTRIEB_UNIT_EOF

# /etc/systemd/system/chroot-web.service
[Unit]
Description=Chrooted web application
Wants=network-online.target
After=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/sbin/chroot --userspec=appsvc:appsvc /srv/app-chroot /usr/bin/python3 -I /opt/app/server.py
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=2s

RestrictSUIDSGID=yes
RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_INET AF_INET6
StandardOutput=null
StandardError=null

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
